summary: Implemented a reusable fail-closed object authorization policy and shared stable contracts for owner, assigned, review-scope, and explicit permission-backed global relations. The evaluator combines actor role, Admin capability where applicable, persisted resource state, and server-established object relations; the same policy derives ordered de-duplicated availableActions. Existing Admin role projections now use the policy without adding or changing any HTTP route.
